title: Tell HN: Bob Cringely has died
why_read: A death notice for a well-known tech journalist, relevant to community sentiment but not technically substantive.
analysis: This is a brief announcement that Bob Cringely, a longtime technology columnist known for commentary on the computer industry, has died. It carries no technical content itself but reflects the HN community's history and nostalgia for tech journalism. The high engagement is driven by sentiment and memory-sharing rather than any new information or technical insight. Readers looking for engineering substance will find nothing here.
